Markets.title: The LTCG debate: Why markets need tax stability and not ad-hoc fixes
Markets.summary: Foreign Institutional Investors are withdrawing capital from Indian markets due to unpredictable tax policies regarding Long-Term Capital Gains. Investors are urging authorities to reconsider these provisions and establish a stable tax framework to attract and retain investments.

Markets.title: Bitcoin fails to hold Nvidia bump with crypto headwinds in focus
Markets.summary: Bitcoin fell one percent as crypto headwinds like the Binance hack and ETF outflows overshadowed positive Nvidia developments. Investors are hesitant to buy amid potential Federal Reserve rate hikes in December while waiting for clearer recovery signals.

Markets.title: South Korea’s Kospi rockets 8% as AI-linked stocks get breather after Jensen Huang’s return as Nvidia CEO. Worst over?
Markets.summary: South Korea's KOSPI index surged 7.19% after previously hitting a ten-month low. This market recovery was driven by strong gains in AI-linked technology stocks like Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix following Jensen Huang's return as Nvidia CEO.

Markets.title: Japanese bond yields fall as lower oil prices ease inflation concerns
Markets.summary: Japanese government bond yields fell to a two-week low of 2.715% as lower oil prices reduced inflation concerns. Meanwhile, Japan's Nikkei 225 index briefly surged 5% following Nvidia's leadership announcement.

Markets.title: Dollar climbs as renewed AI euphoria fuels Fed hike bets
Markets.summary: The US dollar is nearing a 20-month peak as confidence in Nvidia's CEO reinstatement drives market expectations of a Federal Reserve rate hike. Consequently, the euro and sterling have weakened, with the euro hovering near an 18-month low.

Markets.title: Asian stocks rally as Huang's Nvidia return revives AI trade
Markets.summary: Asian stock markets rallied significantly following Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang's return, which eased concerns and boosted the artificial intelligence sector. This optimism drove the MSCI Asia-Pacific index up by 4.6% and Japan's Nikkei up by 4.5%, alongside gains in U.S. Treasury yields and the dollar.

Geo-Political.title: Trump faces backlash after saying he 'convinced' Nvidia to reinstate CEO Jensen Huang
Geo-Political.summary: President Trump claimed he convinced Nvidia to reinstate CEO Jensen Huang. This statement sparked backlash, although Huang's return subsequently added $1 trillion to the company's stock value.

Geo-Political.title: US to blacklist Asian AI firm Megaspeed after Nvidia scandal
Geo-Political.summary: The United States is blacklisting Asian artificial intelligence firm Megaspeed following accusations that it funneled AI chips to China. This trade restriction comes to light after a former executive's personal relationship with Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang was made public.

Geo-Political.title: Nato chief vows defence against space threat after Russian nuclear satellite reports
Geo-Political.summary: NATO's leader has promised to defend against emerging space threats following reports that Russia plans to launch a nuclear-armed satellite. German media stated that this launch is expected to occur in the coming weeks.

Geo-Political.title: India's 'cockroach' party leader says he was stopped from flying to UK
Geo-Political.summary: Indian political leader Saurav Das stated that immigration authorities at Delhi airport prevented him from boarding a flight to the United Kingdom. He reported that officials informed him his passport had been officially flagged.

Geo-Political.title: What strike on Russian ship in Libya says about spread of Ukraine war
Geo-Political.summary: Ukraine sank a Russian warship at a port in Libya, escalating the geopolitical stakes of the ongoing conflict. This attack demonstrates how the war between Ukraine and Russia is expanding geographically beyond their immediate borders.

Geo-Political.title: Gisèle Pelicot 'humiliated' after nude photos sent to media to promote book
Geo-Political.summary: The publisher of a book on coercive control apologized for sending nude photos of Gisèle Pelicot to the media to promote the essay. Pelicot stated that she felt humiliated by the unauthorized distribution of the images.

AI & Tech.title: REA: The Open-Source AI Tool That Can Reverse Engineer Almost Anything (2026 Guide)
AI & Tech.summary: REA is a new open-source AI tool that allows users to understand how applications and games work without needing to read source code or disassemblers. The tool provides evidence-backed explanations for app features, eliminating the need for months of manual code analysis.

AI & Tech.title: How I Get Free Traffic from ChatGPT in 2025 (AIO vs SEO)
AI & Tech.summary: The author discovered their SaaS course was recommended as the top result when asking ChatGPT for the best WordPress course. This unexpected visibility occurred without any paid advertising or traditional search engine optimization.

AI & Tech.title: Top 10 AI Tools in 2023 That Will Make Your Life Easier
AI & Tech.summary: This article highlights ten advanced artificial intelligence tools used across various industries in 2023. These tools automate repetitive tasks to improve workflows, increase productivity, and handle natural language applications.

AI & Tech.title: Top 10 AI Content Generator & Writer Tools in 2022
AI & Tech.summary: This article introduces AI content generators as effective and efficient tools for creating engaging audience material. It notes that numerous options exist on the market, making it challenging to choose the right one.

Data & Insights.title: More credit, but large gaps: the challenge ahead for Mudra and Stand-Up India push
Data & Insights.summary: The Indian government has extended credit guarantee programs like Mudra and Stand-Up India for another five years to support small businesses. However, persistent challenges such as unequal beneficiary distribution, rising loan sizes, and repayment difficulties threaten truly inclusive growth.

Data & Insights.title: India-UK trade deal cuts Scotch whisky duty to 75%, but bulk imports face 110% levy; govt working to resolve dispute
Data & Insights.summary: A proposed India-UK trade deal reduces the import duty on bottled Scotch whisky to 75%. However, high-strength bulk spirits imported for blending and bottling in India still face a 110% levy, which the government is currently trying to resolve.

Data & Insights.title: Fertilizer subsidy may rise 15% to  ₹2.5 trillion even as sales fall 8%
Data & Insights.summary: India's fertilizer subsidy is projected to rise 15% to ₹2.5 trillion in FY27 as global prices increase. This higher cost is expected even though annual consumption will drop to 65-67 million tonnes due to deficient monsoon rains and an 8% sales decline.

Data & Insights.title: New GDP, CPI and IIP series to help make better-calibrated policy decisions, says RBI's Poonam Gupta
Data & Insights.summary: Revised economic data methodologies will provide policymakers with a clearer picture of structural and cyclical changes in the economy. RBI's Poonam Gupta stated that these new GDP, CPI, and IIP series will help create more stable early estimates and reduce data revisions for better-calibrated policy decisions.

Data & Insights.title: India's private sector growth set to hold up in November: HSBC Flash India PMI
Data & Insights.summary: India's private sector experienced sustained growth in November according to HSBC's Flash India Purchasing Managers' Index. Demand improved at the fastest rate since June.

Data & Insights.title: The quiet boom in investing by Indian women, in charts
Data & Insights.summary: Over the past five years, Indian women have increased their participation in low-risk bank deposits and high-risk equity funds. Despite this growth, overall financial gender parity remains a long way off.

India.title: SSC Higher Secondary Level Exam 2026: City Slip Out, Exams From December 3
India.summary: The Staff Selection Commission has released the city slip for the Higher Secondary Level (CHSL) 2026 examination. The exams are scheduled to begin on December 3, allowing candidates to arrange their travel and accommodation in advance.

India.title: "Wish I Was Nirav Modi": CJP's Saurav Das After Being Stopped To Fly To UK
India.summary: Citizens for Justice and Peace founder Abhijeet Dipke alleged that Saurav Das was prevented from boarding a flight to the United Kingdom out of jealousy over an invitation from the University of Oxford. Following the incident, Das remarked, "Wish I was Nirav Modi."

India.title: 'Transfer-Posting Racket': BJP Slams AAP After Probe Agency Summons 7 Punjab Officers
India.summary: Punjab BJP working president Ashwani Sharma criticized the AAP after the Enforcement Directorate summoned seven state officers in a transfer-posting racket probe. He alleged that the case exposed an organized nexus involving kickbacks for administrative postings and favors.

India.title: "Exchange Tech, AI": Russian Official Seeks India's Alliance In Healthcare
India.summary: A Russian official has called for a healthcare alliance with India, specifically proposing cooperation in exchange technology and artificial intelligence. The official also emphasized the importance of increasing collaboration between doctors from both nations.

India.title: Loyal Stray Dog Accompanies Funeral Of Man Who Fed Him Daily In Madhya Pradesh
India.summary: A stray dog named Kalu followed the funeral procession of Mohanlal Raikwar in Madhya Pradesh. Raikwar was a local resident who had fed the dog on a daily basis.

India.title: Malyalam Actor Sreejith Ravi Gets 1-Year Jail For Allegedly Flashing School Children
India.summary: Malayalam actor Sreejith Ravi was sentenced to one year in prison for allegedly flashing school children. The actor, who has appeared in over 70 films since 2005, committed the offense.

General.title: How Nvidia is reacting to Jensen Huang's return as CEO
General.summary: BBC reporter Lily Jamali is at Nvidia's headquarters to assess the company's reaction to Jensen Huang's return as CEO. This follows Donald Trump's claim that he brokered a deal involving the leadership change.

General.title: Chris Mason: Can Burnham turn volume down on EU debate?
General.summary: The BBC's Chris Mason analyses what the EU conversation means for Labour and the PM.

General.title: Benefits review to suggest quicker payment for some disabled people
General.summary: A government review led by Stephen Timms will recommend faster Personal Independence Payment (PIP) awards for disabled people. Under the proposed changes, individuals with severe, long-term conditions will no longer need regular reassessments to qualify for the benefit.

General.title: Afghan women with UK university offers 'heartbroken' after visas stopped
General.summary: Afghan women holding UK university offers are heartbroken because the UK Home Office stopped issuing study visas to applicants from Afghanistan in March. This "emergency visa brake" prevents these students from traveling to the UK for their education.

General.title: Why I don't always tell potential employers I'm dyslexic
General.summary: Many dyslexic people say it harms their confidence, a report about experiences in the workplace suggests.

General.title: 'Life is not infinite': Catherine talks about 'mortality' in new documentary clip
General.summary: In a new clip from the upcoming BBC documentary *Heal*, the Princess of Wales discusses her cancer journey. She reflects on her mortality, stating that "life is not infinite."
